heading: Regex — capacity requirement
text:
### Regex — capacity requirement [LNLS.4.9]

Overlays [LREG.1] (match operators) and [LREG.5] (compiled patterns).

Under `linear_scan: false`, the `~` and `!~` operators are allowed only when the
left-hand operand is a `String` slot with a declared `capacity N`
(LNLS.3.7).  The compiler must:

1. Resolve the operand to its source slot.
2. Check for a `capacity` on that slot.
3. Produce a compile error if the slot declares none.
4. Record `capacity N` in the alpha test metadata so that T_wcet
   computation can use N as the per-match cost bound.
